# Honora Hollis

- **Rank:** Sophomore  <sub>[v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c16 P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a fair, radiant, blonde young woman with an ethereal appearance. She is noticeably tall, standing a solid two inches higher in height than everyone else gathered at her Wexcombe enrollment.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Though she appears dreamy and contemplative, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She possesses a lively spirit and is a firm, driven scholar who easily reassures and cheers her companions.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)_

## History

While attending Regent's Academy, Honora became part of a close circle of scholars alongside friends like Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. After her time at the academy, she was assigned to teach at her home school. During this period, she joined the Brierley Improvement Society, giving a presentation on graveyards and planning essays. Later, she obtained her father's permission to attend Wexcombe College, rooming with Nell in Portmaris. Together with Nell, Mabel Colby, and Cressida Lindsay, she lived at Tabby's Place under the care of Aunt Euphemia. Honora dedicated herself to classical studies throughout her college career and ultimately graduated with Honors in Classics.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
